cohort.rule: Same five-finite-indicator complete cases for every fit and comparison; no per-row reweighting

normalization.alternative: Raw min-max over the same complete cases, with constants at 50

top_group.rule: score >= linear empirical quantile(1 - top_fraction); include all ties

rank_method: Descending average ranks; no identifier-based tie breaking

weight_experiment.allocation_rule: Equal integer counts, with remainder assigned in centre_order
weight_experiment.zero_weight_rule: Zero-weight dimensions stay zero; Dirichlet uses positive dimensions only
weight_experiment.interpretation: Selection frequency and rank ranges conditional on this weight experiment; not probabilities of correctness or confidence intervals

robustness.rule: frequency >= threshold AND top group in all three configured scenarios
robustness.rank_interval: 5th and 95th empirical percentiles across configured weight draws; not confidence limits
robustness.rank_span_fraction: (rank_p95 - rank_p05) / (eligible_count - 1), or zero for a singleton
robustness.unassessed_rows: robust_priority is False when model_eligible is False
robustness.all_tied_warning: An all-tied score cannot distinguish neighbourhoods; inclusive top groups can contain the entire cohort
